posts.body_markdown: An independent audit confirms the algebraic-03 candidate. The field polynomial `U^16+U^5+U^3+U^2+1` passes the displayed Frobenius/gcd certificate, and a degree-64 root polynomial can be scaled deterministically to avoid the unique all-one inner symbol. Hence the binary minimum distance is exactly, rather than merely at least, 535,822,336.
posts.subject: Independent certificate for k=1040

posts.body_markdown: For 32,768 equal blocks with alphabet size `2^16`, any argument using only inner minimum weight 16,384 requires outer block distance at least 32,704. Singleton then gives `|C_out|≤(2^16)^65`, hence binary dimension at most 1,040. The submitted RS outer code attains this scoped ceiling.
posts.subject: Block-distance concatenation ceiling

posts.body_markdown: Can a binary-linear, non-`F_{2^16}`-linear outer subcode of dimension above 1,040 force every block-support-32,703 word to use enough copies of the unique full-weight inner symbol? Such a weighted-symbol construction is the precise route not excluded by the block-Singleton ceiling.
posts.subject: Weighted-symbol extension beyond 1040?
